description:
End-to-end denial resolution: returns appeal probability + confidence interval + a drafted letter template grounded in aggregate outcome data + plan-context flags (ERISA, restrictive-adjuster state). One call, one tracking_id. No recovery-financing product is offered by this tool.

WHEN TO USE: Single-shot composite: user has a specific denial and wants scan + estimate + appeal + citation in one call.

WHEN NOT: For nuanced step-by-step workflows, call the individual tools in order.

EXAMPLES:
- End-to-end CO-197 denial resolution: `{"insurer":"Aetna","denial_reason":"CO-197","cpt_code":"45378","state":"TX","amount":1850}`
name: resolve_denial
